summary: Iter 65 — Kiosk payment: QR code flow REMOVED; Creditcard/iDEAL go directly to payment page. Backend 3/3 new tests + 13/13 iter64 regression = 16/16 pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (430x900): kiosk PIN 4321 login on branded /my-awesome-rentals-bv/login?target=kiosk → location → apartment (HUIS 1A) → amount 50 SRD → method screen 'Hoe wilt u betalen?' shows 4 cards: Contant, Bankoverschrijving, Creditcard ('Direct betalen op dit scherm'), iDEAL ('Direct naar uw bank'). Clicking method-creditcard opens kiosk-stripe-panel rendering stripe-pay-form + stripe-pay-btn immediately with real Stripe iframes (12 Stripe frames detected). NO 'kiosk-stripe-ideal' panel, NO 'QR' text, NO 'telefoon' text, NO toggle. Clicking method-ideal: backend returns non-null redirect_url (https://payments.stripe.com/payment_methods/test_payment?...); frontend auto-opens new tab AND renders kiosk-stripe-ideal panel with kiosk-stripe-ideal-open button + 'Rond de betaling af op de iDEAL-pagina / Wacht op betaling…' — again NO QR. Backend contract verified: POST /api/kiosk/stripe/intent {method:'card'} returns redirect_url=null + client_secret for PaymentElement; {method:'ideal', origin:...} returns non-null stripe.com redirect_url. The sole remaining 'QR' word in codebase is a stale comment on line 8 of /app/frontend/src/pages/KioskStripePay.jsx — cosmetic only, not shown to users.
action_items: (Nit, non-blocking) Update stale comment on line 8 of /app/frontend/src/pages/KioskStripePay.jsx: 'Publieke betaalpagina die de huurder opent via de QR-code op de Kiosk.' — QR flow is removed; this page is now only used as iDEAL return_url. Rephrase to 'Publieke iDEAL-returnpagina' or similar.
critical_code_review_comments: KioskLayout.jsx MethodSelect (~line 2256-2258): clean implementation — stripe methods conditionally appended only when enabled; onClick sets stripeMethod (opens KioskStripePanel) rather than confirming → nice separation.

KioskStripePanel useEffect (~line 2336-2340): intent fetched with origin=window.location.origin; auto-opens bank tab when redirect_url present via window.open then falls back to location.assign if popup blocked — good UX.
Panel branching (line 2368 / 2376): purely redirect_url-driven. No QR code / toggle code paths remain. 'Op dit scherm / QR op telefoon' UX is fully gone.

company_stripe.py kiosk_stripe_intent correctly guards: iDEAL confirm only when origin provided; return_url derived from provided origin — safe against spoofing in combination with company-scoped kiosk auth. redirect_url is None for card as expected.
KioskLayout.jsx is 5294 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting MethodSelect / KioskStripePanel into their own files for maintainability.
Stale comment in KioskStripePay.jsx line 8 references QR — see action_items.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (desktop + mobile E2E through PIN login → location → apartment → amount → method → card panel / iDEAL panel verified; no QR UI anywhere)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST kiosk_stripe_payments intents on company test-mode Stripe keys (50 SRD each). test_iter64 also books 1 real paid intent per run via pm_card_visa. No live money.

Card = PaymentElement form in-panel; iDEAL = backend auto-confirms + returns redirect_url to Stripe bank page which kiosk opens in new tab. rca of the issue: N/A — feature already correctly implemented. Verified removal of QR flow at both API (redirect_url semantics) and UI (no QR toggle / no QR text in panel) levels.
